product_overview: Catat.in is a web-first personal finance recorder that supports manual transactions, wallet management, AI-driven natural-language capture, OCR receipt processing and bank mutation import to reduce friction in daily financial recording.
core_goals: Provide fast, reliable web-first transaction recording (manual + AI + OCR + import).
Ensure data integrity with authenticated APIs and Supabase RLS; enforce free vs premium limits server-side.
Deliver confidence-based AI capture: auto-save only for high-confidence extractions and review-first for low-confidence.
Stabilize AI endpoints (handle provider errors, surface 502 on provider failure) and verify Anthropic credentials before demos/tests.

features.name: Transaction Management
features.description: Create and list user transactions (income/expense), update wallet balances, and support validation rules (e.g., amount > 0).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/transactions with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body {type, amount>0, wallet_id, category, date} -> Receive 201 Created with transaction object containing id, amount, wallet_id, date -> GET /api/v1/transactions?wallet_id=<wallet_id> with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> -> Receive 200 OK with list including created transaction
POST /api/v1/transactions with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body {type, amount:0, wallet_id, category} -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation error 'Nominal harus lebih dari 0'
POST /api/v1/transactions without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Wallet Management
features.description: Create and list wallets (bank, e-wallet, cash) and initialize wallet balance as a recorded initial balance transaction.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/wallets with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body {name, type, balance, currency} -> Receive 201 Created with wallet object including id and balance -> GET /api/v1/wallets with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> -> Receive 200 OK with list containing the new wallet
POST /api/v1/wallets with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> but missing required field name -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation error 'name is required'
GET /api/v1/wallets without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: AI Processing (Natural Language Capture)
features.description: Process natural-language input via AI to extract transaction fields (type, amount, category, wallet) and return extraction + confidence; client may auto-save when confidence >= threshold.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/ai/process with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body {text: 'beli makan siang 28rb di warteg pake BCA'} -> Receive 200 OK with extracted_fields {type, amount, category, wallet_hint} and confidence scores -> POST /api/v1/transactions with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body using extracted_fields -> Receive 201 Created with saved transaction (happy path: client saves after high-confidence extraction)

POST /api/v1/ai/process with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body {text: '...ambiguous input...'} -> Receive 200 OK with partial extracted_fields and low confidence flags (review required) -> Client presents review UI for user to edit before calling POST /api/v1/transactions

POST /api/v1/ai/process with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body {text: '...'} when Anthropic API key is invalid or provider error occurs -> Receive 502 Bad Gateway (or 500 prior to fix) with provider error message sanitized for client (error flow)

features.name: Import Mutasi (Bank Statement Import)
features.description: Upload bank mutation (CSV/XLSX) to preview parsed rows, mark duplicates, and import selected rows into a chosen wallet.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/imports/mutasi with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and multipart/form-data (file: supported CSV/XLSX) and optional params preview=true -> Receive 200 OK with preview payload containing parsed rows and duplicate flags -> POST /api/v1/imports/mutasi with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and body {confirm:true, selected_row_ids, wallet_id} -> Receive 200 OK with import result and created transaction ids (happy path)
POST /api/v1/imports/mutasi with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and file of unsupported format -> Receive 400 Bad Request with message 'Format tidak dikenali. Gunakan CSV atau Excel yang didukung.'
POST /api/v1/imports/mutasi without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

endpoints.description: Process natural language input via AI
